name: Chemnitz

requestOutcomes.outcome: First-party Chemnitz city-plan discovery route identified the official interactive Themenstadtplan; the page was discoverable, though the page fetch was not used as parcel evidence.

Official municipal GIS metadata loaded. It describes Flurstücke polygons, says the dataset is derived from ALKIS, documents EPSG:25833, city bounding box, public native fields, Amt 62 as fachlicher contact, and the current Themenstadtplan link.
Official map viewer HTML loaded and revealed the current map.apps boot/config route; no login or credential flow was used.
Official GeoSN ALKIS-WFS page loaded and documented the state-level open cadastral service context and bounded query capability.
Official city-hosted ArcGIS service metadata loaded. It exposed polygon layers including layer 0 Flurstücke and native service CRS EPSG:25833.
Layer schema loaded: polygon geometry and native fields including FLURST_ID, cadastral components, UUID, and SHAPE.

Bounded anonymous exact-point query returned one polygon with native FLURST_ID CZ-2225/20 and geometry. No unsafe fields were requested. Retained sample contains only canonical id and full polygon geometry.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Native EPSG:25833 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 33N); retained GeoJSON coordinates are EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude because the query requested outSR=4326.

nativeFieldMapping.OBJECTID: ArcGIS object identifier, not canonical identity

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: Not applicable; FLURST_ID was directly returned and used as the canonical native identity.

qualification.reason: A real bounded anonymous polygon response is verified, but citywide coverage and an independently qualified adapter remain outside this research packet.

scopeLimits: The preserved exact WUP point was used as supplied; no coordinate shift was attempted.
One exact-point feature does not prove citywide absence or completeness.
Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS verification disablement were used.
uncertainty: The official local municipal source, state context, schema, CRS, native identity, and one exact-point geometry are verified. Dataset completeness and runtime qualification remain held for serial review.
